sloka: गिरिमूर्ध्नि स्थितां लङ्कां पाण्डुरैर्भवनैः शुभैः ।ददर्श स कपिश्रेष्ठः पुरमाकाशगं यथा ॥५-२-१९॥
transliteration: girimūrdhni sthitāṁ laṅkāṁ pāṇḍurairbhavanaiḥ śubhaiḥ ।dadarśa sa kapiśreṣṭhaḥ puramākāśagaṁ yathā ॥5-2-19॥

translations.english: The foremost among the vanaras, perched on top of the mountain saw the city of Lanka on the mountain with auspicious mansions as though touching the sky.
